description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class named ProductDTO used to transfer product data within a Spring Boot application. It includes product attributes like id, name, description, price, stock quantity, category, image URL, availability, SKU, and timestamps, with validation annotations ensuring data integrity.

classes.name: ProductDTO
classes.description: A data transfer object representing product information with validation constraints and automatic getter/setter generation.
